meta.title: 2024 General Election - Delaware Precincts (Simulated)
meta.note: Simulated precinct-level data based on Delaware 2024 county results and demographic distributions. pct_demo is 0-1 scale.

regression.note: pct_demo is 0-1. In D3 divide axis value by 100 before applying.
regression.d3_snippet: const sigmoid = (x, b0, b1) => 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-(b0 + b1 * (x/100))));
